entities.name: Chiye
entities.description: Non-binary human cook from Kamigawa, member of the Asari Uprisers, with three orbiting teapots used for cooking and combat.

entities.name: Heiko Yamazaki
entities.description: Woman who fled Imperial mechs and joined the Asari Uprisers; close to Chiye.

entities.name: Risona
entities.description: Key figure of the Asari Uprisers whom Chiye introduced to Heiko.

entities.name: Norika Yamazaki
entities.description: Imperial commander and Heiko's estranged cousin.

entities.name: Asari Uprisers
entities.description: Group of rebels on Kamigawa to which Chiye and Heiko belong.

entities.name: Sokenzanshi
entities.description: City on Kamigawa where Chiye's café stands and whose hungry people the Uprisers aid.

entities.name: Imperial Council
entities.description: Ruling council with which Norika promises to address the city's demands.

events.summary: Exhausted Heiko, chased by Imperial mechs, stumbles into Chiye's café and Chiye feeds her.
events.quote: Chiye recognized Heiko's distress and offered her a meal

events.summary: Chiye introduces Heiko to Risona and Heiko joins the Asari Uprisers.
Twelve years later Heiko and Chiye are caught robbing an Imperial train car and brought before Norika.
Norika agrees to negotiate rather than imprison them and promises to address some demands with the Imperial Council.
events.quote: Norika agreed to negotiate rather than imprison Heiko and Chiye

relations.quote: who is a member of the Asari Uprisers
their close relationship with Heiko Yamazaki
